head_commit.message:
Limit ephemeral context payload size on turn start

Count ephemeralContext title/text toward the existing turn input size
limit so clients cannot bypass MAX_USER_INPUT_TEXT_CHARS with oversized
context blocks. Also tighten the field description to explain that
clients should resend fresh snapshots because ephemeral context is not
re-injected after compaction.

Tests:
- cargo test -p codex-app-server-protocol
- cargo test -p codex-app-server
